title: Electron exchange capacity of dissolved natural organic matter: further method development and interpretation using square wave voltammetry in dimethyl sulfoxide
content:
Environ. Sci.: Processes Impacts, 2025, 27,917-935
DOI: 10.1039/D4EM00555D, Paper
Jeffrey M. Hudson, Han Cao, Wenqing Xu, Paul G. Tratnyek
Square wave voltammetry in DMSO is further developed to measure electron exchange capacities (EEC) of dissolved natural organic matter (NOM). The significance of measured EECs using this method are discussed and compared to conventional techniques.
